sentences.text: Nannosuchus is an extinct genus of goniopholidid mesoeucrocodylian, a group belonging to the family Goniopholididae.

The type species Nannosuchus gracilidens was originally described in 1879 based on scattered fragmentary remains including parts of the skull and postcranial elements. The genus was formally described by Salisbury in 2002.
There are three recorded fossil occurrences of Nannosuchus in the Paleobiology Database.

Fossils of this animal have been found in the Berriasian Middle Purbeck Formation of England. It lived during the Berriasian and persisted until the Barremian, between 143.1 and 121.4 million years ago.
